title: Russia diesel short
hook: Trump signed Russia sanctions… then waived them 3 weeks later?!

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: On September eighteenth, President Trump signed one of the *toughest Russia sanctions laws* in years.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: That law lets the president put tariffs of up to *100 percent* on buyers of Russian oil.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Three weeks later, he *suspended* U.S. sanctions on Russian diesel.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: It came right after a *phone call with Putin*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Trump says Russia will send up to *4.8 million tons* of diesel to world markets.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: The reason? Diesel near *record highs*, weeks before the midterms.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: U.S. diesel hit a record of about *six dollars and twenty nine cents* a gallon in September.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Ukraine's Zelensky called it *not fair and not honest*, a gift to Putin.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: And lawmakers from *both parties* are furious.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Republican Congressman Don Bacon said propping up Russia's war economy is *terrible*.

lines.speaker: Anchor
lines.text: Will it actually lower prices? Watch the *full story* on our channel.
